variants.headline: Home world changes the charter
variants.sub: An amendment to the colony's charter has been made by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has changed the colony's charter. A change to the governing framework deserves a precise account, not a guess at the powers affected. In considering {target}, readers should distinguish the fact of amendment from any particular new permission or restriction not specified in this report.

Workers have a stake in the framework within which political choices are made. A charter should not be treated as too distant a subject for ordinary people. Labour must ask how authority is justified and whose voice counts, while leaving unreported changes to specific rights outside the factual account.

We support {target} in this assessment. A charter change deserves judgment on its merits, rather than condemnation merely because the framework has been altered by an authority exercising its claimed role. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.
